## isva-p04-v36 — argument map

**Speaker.** Utpaladeva (siddhāntin)

**Question.** Does pradhāna will?

**Premises.**
- Nor (na) of pradhāna (pradhānasya) desire-etc.-arising (icchādi saṃbhavaḥ)...
- person-aim-ness (puruṣārthatā).

**Inference.** Pradhāna will-less — yet person-aim-ness stands.


### Open
- na-scope ambiguous (denies arising? or denies puruṣārthatā?); read as fencing will off pradhāna, keeping puruṣārthatā — held open.
